## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change addresses it. Link any related issue.

## Verification

List commands, results, runtime versions and any checks not performed. Use synthetic data only.

## Review considerations

- [ ] No secrets, personal information, business records or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Permission, KPI, API or migration changes and compatibility risks are explained.
- [ ] Any third-party material is identified with its source and license.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this change under AGPL-3.0-only.
